summary: Receives image streams from an external Ncam Reality tracking system through an Ncam CHOP, including film, lens-distortion, depth, distorted input, and composite outputs.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Request image data from the Ncam server

key_params.name: chop
key_params.note: Ncam CHOP connected to the Ncam server

key_params.name: output
key_params.note: composite, distort, distort_passthrough, film_passthrough, or depth_passthrough

common_gotchas: Composite and Distort Input modes require an input TOP to warp or composite.
Unavailable server streams produce errors, even if the operator and CHOP are configured.
Turning active off stops image requests but does not deactivate the referenced Ncam CHOP.
Official docs mark Ncam TOP as TouchDesigner Pro only.
key_concepts: Receives image streams from an external Ncam Reality tracking system.
Requires a connected Ncam CHOP as the server/tracking data source.
Output modes include film passthrough, depth passthrough, distortion-map passthrough, distorted input, and composite.
The distortion map is a 32-bit float image whose red and green channels store source coordinates.
Multiple Ncam TOPs can access different streams from the same Ncam setup.
Official docs mark Ncam TOP as TouchDesigner Pro only.
